query:
SELECT s.id, s.companyName, s.userId, u.name, u.email, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetings m WHERE m.sponsorId = s.id AND m.isVisible = 1 AND (m.status = 'suggested' OR m.status = 'confirmed')) as meetingCount
FROM sponsors s 
LEFT JOIN users u ON s.userId = u.id 
WHERE s.companyName NOT LIKE 'Test%' AND s.companyName NOT LIKE 'Visibility%' AND s.companyName NOT LIKE 'AI Limited' AND s.companyName NOT LIKE 'Elevate%' AND s.companyName NOT LIKE 'Little Moment' AND s.companyName NOT LIKE 'NexaTalent%'
ORDER BY s.companyName;
